item.title: Efficient Quantum Measurements: Computational Max- and Measured Rényi Divergences and Applications
item.description:
Overview

This article introduces computational max-divergence and computational measured Rényi divergences constrained by efficient binary measurements, and develops applications to hypothesis testing and quantum resource quantification.
